Claim 1 (Currently amended): A preventing or treating agent for glaucoma comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent is formulated for __treatment of glaucoma__.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): A preventing or treating agent for ocular hypertension comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent is formulated for __treatment of ocular hypertension__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): A composition for eye drops comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof and a pharmaceutically accepted carrier, wherein the composition is for __treatment of glaucoma or ocular hypertension__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): A method for [[preventing or]] treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): A method for [[preventing or]] treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered.

Claim 9 (Previously presented): A method for treating glaucoma comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

Claim 10 (Previously presented): A method for treating ocular hypertention comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): A method for __reducing intraocular pressure in a subject with glaucoma or ocular hypertension__, wherein phosphoric acid or a salt thereof is combined with (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof.

Claim 12 (Cancelled): [[A method for reducing intraocular pressure from the normal level, which method comprises administering a combination of (S)-(-)-l-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine, or its salt, and phosphoric acid, or a salt thereof, to a person having normal intraocular pressure.]]
